title: emd creation process
text: EMD Creation Process For a Seller to participate in a Bid on GeM -- 1 of 14 -- For a Seller to participate in a Bid Click here to login as Seller EMD Creation -- 2 of 14 -- Click here to Login as Enter your login credentials and click on SUBMIT button. -- 3 of 14 -- Enter your details and Click on Bids and search for open Bid(s) -- 4 of 14 -- Click on Bids to see open Click on Participate to make an Offer against a Bid -- 5 of 14 -- Click on Participate to make an Offer MSE & Start- Up Sellers are not required to submit EMD. They should click on SAVE to proceed. -- 6 of 14 -- As MSME/Start-up Sellers are not required to submit EMD, Sellers who are not MSE/ Start- Up, should download & print the EMD Draft Document for reference of EMD details. Please take EMD Draft Document to the bank where your company account is maintained and get Bank Guarantee issued. For Uploading EMD Receipt, the Seller should Login, search & click on Participate in the same Bid, upload EMD Receipt and click on SAVE. -- 7 of 14 -- Submission of EMD depends on where the Seller has a Bank Account Submission of EMD depends on where the Seller is having Bank Account Ensure that you collect physical EMD Receipt. Please note name and E-mail ID of Branch Manager. -- 8 of 14 -- Submission of EMD depends on where the Seller has a bank Account in Bank which is mentioned as Advisory 1 2 Receipt received on email on the GeM Account in any other 1 2 3 4 3 4 5 Ensure that you collect physical EMD Receipt. Please note down Branch Manager -- 9 of 14 -- Return to this screen after login and selecting the same Bid and Click on Choose File and upload the EMD You will get this message on successful upload. Click on OK to proceed -- 10 of 14 -- Upon successful upload, Click on OK to Enter details as mentioned in EMD Receipt issued by the bank and click on SAVE -- 11 of 14 -- Read and Accept the Terms & Conditions and E-Sign Read and Accept Terms & Conditions and Verify your Offer Document by entering OTP received on your registered Mobile Number. Sellers who are not MSE or Start -Up, please ensure that you submit physical EMD receipt to the Buyer. -- 12 of 14 -- Lastly, read and accept the Terms & Conditions and E-sign your Offer document Sellers who are not MSME or Start- Up please ensure that you submit physical Please Contact Your Bank Incase, after OTP Verficiation and Offer Submission you receive an e-mail communication stating that the Online Verfication of your EMD Receipt has failed. -- 13 of 14 -- After you have E-Signed and submitted Just in case you receive an email communication stating that online verification of -- 14 of 14 --
